55/S0.subgoal: Introduce the concept of resource optimization and the 3D graphics pipeline.

55/S1.subgoal: Explain the definition and necessity of the 3D graphics pipeline.

55/S2.subgoal: Describe the first stage of the pipeline, object representation.

55/S3.subgoal: Explain how modeling transformation places objects into a common coordinate system.

55/S4.subgoal: Describe the function of the lighting stage in 3D scene rendering.

55/S5.subgoal: Explain how viewing transformation maps a 3D scene to a 2D device coordinate space.

55/S6.subgoal: Explain the process of scan conversion from device space to a discrete pixel grid.

55/S7.subgoal: Summarize the five stages of the 3D graphics pipeline and the coordinate systems involved.

55/S8.subgoal: Identify the challenges and broad categories of object representation techniques.

55/S9.subgoal: Describe boundary representation techniques, such as mesh and spline representation.

55/S10.subgoal: Describe space partitioning methods and specialized techniques for complex objects.

55/S11.subgoal: Review the major stages and coordinate systems of the 3D graphics pipeline.
